name: Warren County, TN
findings: Warren County has 90 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Warren County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Warren County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Warren County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
